title: A profile of Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao, who tends to take a conservative approach to revenue projections and has chosen to raise less money than is available (Kate Clark/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Kate Clark / Wall Street Journal: A profile of Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao, who tends to take a conservative approach to revenue projections and has chosen to raise less money than is available — Krishna Rao is navigating unprecedented growth, compute constraints and the idiosyncratic Amodeis
